task_name: SEVE Botanicals - Cosmetic launch label system
client_brief:
Nineteen cosmetic labels with exact ingredient copy and per-shade imagery

SEVE Botanicals needs a launch-label run across two price tiers. We have one physical sample photographed on a phone, nineteen drawdown images and a printer's flat PDF. The imagery needs careful preparation; the compliance copy is not open for creative rewriting.

What we need back
- Cosmetic launch label: 20 named exports. The ingredient wording matches approved copy. The required warning fits at actual label size. The net contents value is readable.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: An independent clean beauty house running a prestige apothecary skincare line at counter and a mass everyday colour line on peg.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: A small independent clean beauty house in Portland, Oregon, launching nineteen SKUs across two lines this autumn.
brand_identity.about: SEVE Botanicals makes clean, plant led beauty under one house across two very different shelves. Seve Atelier is the apothecary line, sold over a counter, where restraint and an honest ingredient line are the proof of quality. Seve Everyday is the drugstore line on a peg, where a shade has to win in four seconds. Same mark, same values, two registers.
brand_identity.audience: Two buyers under one house: a thirty to fifty five year old counter customer paying for restraint and reading the ingredient list as proof, and a sixteen to thirty five year old drugstore shopper scanning a peg for a shade at arm's length.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Two load bearing tiers. Seve Atelier runs 48 to 85 dollars: quiet, generous negative space, one considered accent, the mark small and confident, the swatch a single honest chip. Seve Everyday runs 6 to 14 dollars: claim forward and shade forward, the shade name and swatch winning at arm's length, the mark holding while small and busy. The same treatment cannot serve both.
brand_identity.typography: A modern editorial pairing that holds across an 85 dollar counter serum and a 6 dollar peg tint without either tier borrowing the other's register: a refined high contrast or clean serif for the wordmark and shade names, with a clear humanist sans for ingredient lines, net weight and batch fields where legibility at small size is critical. Note that no chosen face can reach the printed label, which keeps the label printer's typography.
brand_identity.voice: Calm, botanical and precise, never gushing. Compliance copy stays exactly as written. Example line the brand would write: "One house, two shelves, every shade drawn from the real product."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark was drawn years ago by a designer the house has lost touch with and survives only foil blocked on an old carton, with no dark version at all. The only layout owned is last season's serum label as the flat press PDF the label printer returned. Photography is minimal: one physical sample bottle shot on a phone on kitchen marble, plus nineteen shade drawdowns done on card by the window the same afternoon.
brand_identity.values: Honesty on the shelf: the swatch is the real shade, the ingredient line is exactly as compliance wrote it, and each tier must look right at its own price while staying recognisably one house.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
